helper_distribution.build: compile helper in CI with Go, distribute the resulting native executable
helper_distribution.runtime_note: Go runtime is linked into the helper executable; user does not install Go

candidates.syntax_fidelity: official Go parser/AST for the helper's Go language version
candidates.symbol_resolution: go/types performs name resolution, type deduction, interface/generic checking and exposes Defs/Uses/Selections
candidates.packages_imports: project sources can be grouped and type-checked with a custom importer/resolver
candidates.incomplete_source_recovery: parser/type checker diagnostics and partial AST are available for some errors; not optimized for malformed editor buffers
candidates.packaging: single native helper executable; no external Go runtime/toolchain required

candidates.syntax_fidelity: loads parsed syntax and complete Types/TypesInfo when requested
candidates.symbol_resolution: excellent project/package loading when build environment is available
candidates.runtime_constraint: default driver invokes the go command; therefore not a mandatory runtime path
workspace loading depends on Go tooling/module environment and protocol surface is larger than Tomiya needs
candidates.packaging: could bundle binary, but would still increase integration and toolchain/environment assumptions

candidates.syntax_fidelity: insufficient for Common IR semantic analysis

project_strategy.package_grouping: group discovered .go files by directory/package declaration
project_strategy.internal_imports: Tomiya project discovery resolves project-local source packages and feeds them to the helper importer
project_strategy.vendored_sources: prefer discovered vendor/source trees when present
project_strategy.external_imports: unavailable external packages remain explicitly unresolved in self-contained mode
project_strategy.toolchain_mode: optionally enable go/packages only when a compatible Go toolchain is intentionally available; never silently require it
project_strategy.common_ir_boundary: only normalized Common IR/wire DTOs cross into the Python host

known_limits: Exact module/build-tag behavior can depend on the Go toolchain, GOOS/GOARCH and build constraints.
Self-contained mode may not fully resolve external module packages unless source/vendor metadata is available.
The helper's parser syntax ceiling follows the Go version used to build the backend.
go/packages is not used as the mandatory path because its default driver invokes the go command.
